model.name: Audio files play in the preview (HTML5 player)
model.description: When an audio file (mp3, wav, ogg, or m4a) is dropped or uploaded into a room, the preview pane renders an HTML5 audio player with play, pause, seek, and volume controls.
model.tronQuote: > TRON: "MP3 files must play audio in the preview. When an MP3 (or audio file) is dropped/uploaded into a room, the preview pane renders an HTML5 audio player with play/pause/seek/volume. Support mp3/wav/ogg/m4a."

acceptanceCriteria.text: Dropping/uploading an audio file into a room stores it and offers it in the preview.
The preview pane renders an HTML5 <audio controls> player for the file.
The player provides play/pause, seek, and volume controls.
Supported types: mp3, wav, ogg, m4a (correct MIME/<source> per extension).
Verified live (headless): an audio file in a room renders the player and is playable.

model.crossRefNote: Extends the R21.9 preview pane (rb-preview-pane / ContentPreviewer) with an audio content type.
